title: Issue discovery deduplication: validate each merge group's indices and skip the whole malformed group, never partially apply it
answers: Issue discovery crashed with IndexError after the model proposed a dedup group with an out-of-range index like [0, 3] for three candidate issues
Why did a finding's description get overwritten or two unrelated findings merge during issue discovery deduplication?
Where are the deduplication merge proposals from the LLM validated before merging issues in discovery?
How should a malformed merge proposal be handled so other valid merges in the same discovery run still apply?
body:
Path: Issue discovery deduplication, the step that takes the LLM's merge proposals (groups of candidate issue indices) and folds the matching issues together; the chokepoint is mlflow/genai/discovery/pipeline.py:_dedup_issues, which builds group_by_root from result.groups before any merge state or issue metadata changes.
Rule: Check every proposed group before mutating anything: at least two indices, no duplicates, no negative values, and every index below len(issues). If any check fails, skip the entire group and log it with _logger.debug; do not drop only the bad indices, because the merged name/description was written for the full proposed set. Keep processing the remaining groups.
Symptom: Discovery run raised IndexError on an out-of-range index; negative indices silently merged the wrong findings; repeated indices overwrote an issue's description without merging distinct findings.
Constraints: Applies to the LLM dedup proposal path in _dedup_issues only. Valid overlapping groups still merge transitively via the root/union logic, so a malformed group must not be allowed to overwrite a root already set by a valid group in either order. No prompt or public API change.
applies: Use when changing or adding validation for deduplication/merge groups in MLflow GenAI issue discovery; not for other evaluation metrics or non-LLM merges.
says: Issue discovery crashes unexpectedly while grouping duplicate findings together.
Unrelated findings are mistakenly merged together during the automated discovery deduplication step.
A discovered issue had its description overwritten instead of merging distinct findings.
Skip invalid duplicate merge suggestions without halting the rest of the discovery run.
search: Deduplication in MLflow GenAI issue discovery validates proposed merge index groups in mlflow/genai/discovery/pipeline.py:_dedup_issues before mutating issue state. Proposed groups with fewer than two indices, duplicates, negative values, or out-of-range indices are skipped entirely and logged via _logger.debug rather than partially applied. Applies to LLM merge proposals in _dedup_issues to prevent IndexErrors, incorrect finding merges, and description overwrites, without modifying prompts or public APIs.
